Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed Smart Action casts in Crystalline Conflict always falling back to the visible tab target before S1-S5 ranking. Exact harmful PvP casts now continue through the same reachable Smart Target selection, target freeze, protection recheck, and sole native call as instant Smart Action attacks. Near Assist and Near Help keep their authored-target cast protection, and instant actions are unchanged. FFXIV may perform its ordinary initial auto-face toward the frozen cast target; later manual target changes cannot rerank or retarget that cast through Seiton. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
